menu.quit_submessage: The system collapses in your absence.

game.title: SACRIFICE
game.win_message: You have successfully navigated the complexities of your kingdom for {{years}} years.
game.loss_message: Your rule has come to a tragic end in year {{year}}, Term {{term}}.
game.exit_confirm_desc: Are you sure you want to return to the hub? Current progress will be lost.
game.hover_instruction: Hover over an option to view advisor projections...

slides: The revolution is over. The old regime has fallen. You stand victorious in the ashes.
But victory is fragile. The Sepah demands control. The Bonyads demand wealth. The Ideology demands obedience. You cannot satisfy them all.
You are the Supreme Leader. How long can you survive the system you created?

death_reasons.sepah_min: Without the military to protect the borders, foreign adversaries and internal separatists have fractured the nation.
death_reasons.sepah_max: The generals have decided they no longer need a civilian government. A military coup has deposed you.
death_reasons.piety_min: The clerics have declared you an apostate. The streets fill with zealots calling for your head.
death_reasons.piety_max: The hardliners have completely taken over. You are no longer the leader, merely a figurehead for ideological purity.
death_reasons.bazaar_min: The economy has completely collapsed. Bread riots have turned into a full-scale revolution.
death_reasons.bazaar_max: The Bonyads and oligarchs have bought the entire state. You have been quietly replaced by a corporate puppet.
death_reasons.isolation_min: The borders opened completely. Unrestricted foreign influence has overwhelmed the state, forcing a regime change.
death_reasons.isolation_max: The country is entirely cut off from the world. Total systemic collapse has occurred due to a lack of basic imports.

piety.title: The Great Cathedral
piety.description: The Ministry of Guidance proposes a grand construction project to solidify the faith of the people.

piety.title: Religious Census
piety.description: Should we force all citizens to register their faith, or allow private worship?

piety.title: The Morality Patrols
piety.description: Hardliners demand increased funding for street-level morality patrols to enforce the public dress code.

piety.title: University Purge
piety.description: Student groups are organizing unauthorized political debates. The clerics want the ringleaders expelled.

piety.title: State Media Monopoly
piety.description: Underground satellite dishes are spreading foreign culture. Do we jam the signals?

piety.title: The Friday Imams
piety.description: Local prayer leaders are demanding the state ban all western music from public cafes.

piety.title: Shrine Restoration
piety.description: A massive budget is proposed to gild the domes of the holy shrines, draining public infrastructure funds.

piety.title: Textbook Revision
piety.description: The Ministry of Education wants to rewrite history books to emphasize martyrdom over scientific achievement.

piety.title: Strict Hijab Enforcement
piety.description: Reports of widespread non-compliance with hijab laws spark outrage among clerics who demand expanded enforcement units.

piety.title: Mandatory Religious Programming
piety.description: State television airs secular entertainment. Clerics demand a minimum quota of religious content.

piety.title: Cleric Legislative Veto
piety.description: Hardline clerics propose granting the Guardian Council absolute veto power over all laws.

piety.title: National Anti-Vice Campaign
piety.description: Mixed-gender parties and alcohol consumption are rising. Launch a nationwide campaign?

piety.title: Madrasa Expansion
piety.description: Divert university budgets to expand religious seminaries across the country.

piety.title: Ban Valentine\'s Celebrations
piety.description: Shops openly sell Valentine\'s gifts, seen as Western corruption.

piety.title: Extended Holy Defense Week
piety.description: Veterans and clerics want a full month of mandatory commemoration events.

piety.title: National Censorship Board
piety.description: Establish a permanent board to review all publications for religious compliance.

piety.title: Redirect Charity Funds
piety.description: Divert public charity funds primarily to support clergy families.

piety.title: Workplace Prayer Mandate
piety.description: Require all workplaces to provide prayer rooms and enforced prayer breaks.

sepah.title: Border Skirmish
sepah.description: The Supreme National Security Council reports minor incursions. A show of force is requested.

sepah.title: New Armored Division
sepah.description: The generals request funds for a new mechanized unit to "ensure peace through strength."

sepah.title: Port Smuggling
sepah.description: Intelligence reports the Sepah is bypassing customs at the southern ports to fund black-ops.

sepah.title: Regional Proxies
sepah.description: Our allied militias in neighboring countries need advanced missile shipments to maintain influence.

sepah.title: Cyber Command
sepah.description: The generals want to build a domestic intranet to completely isolate citizens from the global web.

sepah.title: Quell the Strike
sepah.description: Oil refinery workers are striking for unpaid wages. The Sepah offers to break the strike by force.

sepah.title: Consolidate Bonyads
sepah.description: The military wants to absorb three major charitable foundations into their corporate conglomerate.

sepah.title: Drone Manufacturing
sepah.description: Foreign buyers are offering hard currency for our combat drones, but it will provoke sanctions.

sepah.title: Basij Mobilization
sepah.description: Basij volunteers request full mobilization for internal security duties.

sepah.title: Satellite Launch Program
sepah.description: Military proposes launching new reconnaissance satellites despite sanction threats.

sepah.title: Mass Dissident Arrests
sepah.description: Intelligence has compiled lists of opposition figures for preventive detention.

sepah.title: Military Factory Expansion
sepah.description: Sepah proposes taking over additional civilian factories for defense production.

sepah.title: Increased Proxy Funding
sepah.description: Regional allies request significantly higher funding and arms shipments.

sepah.title: Martial Law in Provinces
sepah.description: Ethnic unrest in border provinces. Sepah offers to impose martial law.

sepah.title: Veterans Pension Increase
sepah.description: War veterans demand higher pensions and benefits.

sepah.title: Naval Build-Up
sepah.description: Expand the navy with new destroyers and submarines.

sepah.title: Foreign Intelligence Budget
sepah.description: Double funding for overseas intelligence operations.

sepah.title: Protest Suppression
sepah.description: Large protests in major cities. Sepah volunteers to disperse them.

bazaar.title: The Steel Tariff
bazaar.description: The Bonyads demand protection for local industries. The Bazaris are divided.

bazaar.title: Market Subsidy
bazaar.description: The price of bread is rising. Should we subsidize the merchants to prevent riots?

bazaar.title: Currency Collapse
bazaar.description: The Rial is in freefall. Merchants demand we inject foreign reserves to stabilize the market.

bazaar.title: The Carpet Exporters
bazaar.description: Traditional artisans are going bankrupt due to border closures. They beg for an export corridor.

bazaar.title: Black Market Crackdown
bazaar.description: The informal economy is thriving while state coffers empty. Should we raid the black market?

bazaar.title: Foreign Investment
bazaar.description: A European conglomerate wants to modernize our telecom infrastructure. The hardliners object.

bazaar.title: Price Controls
bazaar.description: Inflation is destroying the middle class. Do we mandate strict price ceilings on basic food items?

bazaar.title: Bonyad Tax Evasion
bazaar.description: State-linked religious charities (Bonyads) control 30% of the economy but pay no taxes. Force them to pay?

bazaar.title: Partial Oil Privatization
bazaar.description: Merchants push to privatize select oil fields to attract foreign capital.

bazaar.title: Luxury Goods Imports
bazaar.description: Wealthy merchants want to import luxury cars and electronics.

bazaar.title: Stock Market Liberalization
bazaar.description: Reform the Tehran Stock Exchange to allow foreign investors.

bazaar.title: Agricultural Subsidies
bazaar.description: Farmers and food merchants demand subsidies to keep bread prices low.

bazaar.title: Cryptocurrency Legalization
bazaar.description: Young traders want to legalize cryptocurrency exchanges.

bazaar.title: Tourism Campaign
bazaar.description: Hotel owners and merchants push for a major international tourism drive.

bazaar.title: Labor Law Relaxation
bazaar.description: Factory owners want relaxed labor laws to reduce costs.

bazaar.title: Sanctions-Evasion Networks
bazaar.description: Merchants propose expanding unofficial trade networks to bypass sanctions.

bazaar.title: Infrastructure Bonds
bazaar.description: Issue government bonds to fund ports and highways, favored by construction merchants.

bazaar.title: Guild Autonomy
bazaar.description: Traditional bazaar guilds demand greater autonomy from state regulation.

isolation.title: The Cultural Exchange
isolation.description: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs suggests inviting western artists to a local festival.

isolation.title: Global Sanctions
isolation.description: Foreign powers threaten sanctions unless we halt our independent research.

isolation.title: The Nuclear Inspector
isolation.description: UN inspectors are requesting access to an undisclosed military site. Refusal guarantees heavy sanctions.

isolation.title: Diaspora Assets
isolation.description: Exiled citizens want to invest in the homeland. Should we offer them amnesty to bring in their capital?

isolation.title: Embassy Siege
isolation.description: Student radicals have surrounded a Western embassy. They want to breach the gates to prove a point.

isolation.title: Hostage Diplomacy
isolation.description: We have detained a dual-citizen journalist. Foreign governments are offering unfreezing of assets for their release.

isolation.title: The Cyber Attack
isolation.description: State hackers have crippled a rival nation\'s power grid. We can claim responsibility or stay quiet.

isolation.title: Regional Summit
isolation.description: A neutral neighbor is hosting a peace summit. Attending means sitting at the same table as our sworn enemies.

isolation.title: Major Trade Deal
isolation.description: A global power offers a comprehensive trade agreement in exchange for policy concessions.

isolation.title: Human Rights Inquiry
isolation.description: International monitors request access to prisons for a human rights report.

isolation.title: Joint Naval Exercise
isolation.description: Neighbor invites participation in naval drills with Western observers present.

isolation.title: Political Exile Amnesty
isolation.description: Offer amnesty to political exiles in exchange for their investment capital.

isolation.title: Internet Unfiltering
isolation.description: Lift most restrictions on global internet access.

isolation.title: Foreign Humanitarian Aid
isolation.description: Accept large-scale humanitarian aid packages from international organizations.

isolation.title: Restore Diplomatic Ties
isolation.description: Opportunity to restore full diplomatic relations with a long-time adversary.

isolation.title: Climate Accord
isolation.description: Sign an international climate agreement requiring emissions monitoring.

isolation.title: UNESCO Heritage Bid
isolation.description: Apply for UNESCO World Heritage status for ancient sites, requiring foreign experts.

isolation.title: Prisoner Swap
isolation.description: Western country proposes a prisoner exchange involving political detainees.
